thread:
maria_marketing: ok team — we need a short sync on the go-live copy for the product pages (hosted API / dedicated / private). target: homepage + three landing pages + webinar sign-up hero. want final copy by friday.
jamal_growth: goals? conversion metrics to optimize for?
maria_marketing: primary: free trial signups and webinar RSVPs. secondary: enterprise leads for Dedicated/Private. also want a small benchmark narrative piece on latency/cost for blog/hero callout.
ellie_design: can we keep hero lines tight — 6–8 words max. imagery: split-screen showing hosted on left, private on right?
lisa_content: sketching headline options: 
- "Inference that scales — anywhere you run it."
- "Predictable latency. Predictable cost. One API."
- "Ship LLM features with production-grade inference."
Which direction do we like?
jamal_growth: second one is strong for devs. first one sounds more infra-y and might help Dedicated/Private. maybe A/B test across hero variants.
tom_product: routing question — for the Dedicated/Private pages should CTA go straight to sales form or to a qualify + schedule flow? we don't want to scare self-serve users.
maria_marketing: idea: page-level routing rules: 
- Hosted API CTA -> sign up + start free trial (self-serve)
- Dedicated CTA -> request capacity (lead form, score > 60 -> sales outreach)
- Private CTA -> contact sales (enterprise flow)
Can we implement via GTM and HubSpot?
jamal_growth: yes. propose lead route mapping in HubSpot: property "product_interest" = hosted/dedicated/private. Then workflow assigns lifecycle stage and SLA.
ellie_design: microcopy for the hosted CTA: "Start free trial — 500 free calls". For Dedicated: "Request reserved capacity". For Private: "Talk to an engineer".
lisa_content: adding a lightweight benchmark blurb for hero: "Latencies as low as 9ms token time; up to 3x cost savings with caching & batching" — want to be careful with exact numbers. can we use ranges?
tom_product: stick to conservative phrasing: "Single-digit token latencies in production" and "typical cost reductions up to 3x with caching"
jamal_growth: for webinar hook copy: "Shipping LLM features: how teams cut latency & cost in production" — we can gate the replay behind a quick signup. CTA: "Save my seat" or "Watch the replay" if post-launch.
maria_marketing: nice. also need short social post copy and one-liner for hero meta description. social: 1 tweet / 2 linked in variants.
ellie_design: please keep CTA contrast and include a small badge on Hosted hero: "No credit card required"
lisa_content: rough hero meta one-liner: "Redwood Inference — unified runtime for hosted, dedicated, and private LLM inference. Predictable latency and cost."
jamal_growth: tracking/UTM plan: add utm_source=launch, utm_medium=site, utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch and utm_content=hosted/dedicated/private. also set hidden field product_interest.
---
Code snippet for the HubSpot hidden field to attach on CTAs: 
```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"product_interest\" value=\"hosted\">
```
---
maria_marketing: timeline check: copy freeze Thurs EOD, assets in by Friday AM, pushing to staging Friday afternoon. can we do a soft launch to a small segment before the public email?
jamal_growth: yes — 2% of traffic and a targeted beta list. use feature flag to switch hero variants.
ellie_design: tagging: add aria-labels + alt text for split imagery. I'll add microcopy for accessibility.
tom_product: one more ask — add a short "compatibility" section on each page listing supported model families and quantization options. 2–3 bullet lines.
lisa_content: I'll draft page copy now and post links to the staging doc. anyone wants to pair on headline A/B testing? @jamal_growth?
jamal_growth: happy to pair. after copy freeze I'll wire up experiments in GA4 and our internal dashboard. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-03-20T18:00:00Z (pipeline: web-landing-v3)
maria_marketing: amazing—thanks all. I'll compile final copy matrix and the routing table and drop it in #marketing later today. :rocket:
